description:
Outcome: Resolve interaction and retention choices before persistence implementation, from BRIEF.md and owner constraints.
Scope: Review sketch and data lifecycle. Excludes: SMS and implementation.
Question: Confirm trusted local network without sign-in, FIFO, anonymous references for duplicate first names, any repairer may finish, and configured cafe timezone (default host timezone displayed in controls). Resolve storage conflict explicitly: daily SQLite survives restarts but cannot delete while powered off; choose volatile storage or an explicit owner ruling on operating limitations. The requirement nothing kept after day ends remains binding until ruled otherwise.
Artifact: Door form: first name and repair item; repairer waiting/helped lists with references and take-next/finish controls; public board: first name/status/reference only. Proposed durable lifecycle: close and remove daily database and sidecars at running midnight; purge expired stores before startup accepts requests. Alternative: volatile queue loses entries on restart. Neither option permits visitor payload logs, browser persistence or backups.
Acceptance: Explicit recorded owner ruling resolves retention and reviews sketch.
Behaviour: Unresolved retention blocks queue storage work.
Verification: Recorded decision, not inferred from setup approval. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: one volunteer, 3-6 repairers, visitor display.
Stage-1 limitation: ordinary checkpoint ticket, not a technically enforced approval gate.
Setup label: C1.
title: Checkpoint: privacy and interaction sketch
